## September 1 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 534)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1** across Cecil B. DeMille and William Keighley's Hollywood prestige drama, romantic comedy half-hours, and historical news broadcasts covering the first day of World War II and the London child evacuations, Lionel Barrymore and Margaret O'Brien in *Three Wise Fools* on *Lux Radio Theatre* (1947), Jane Wyatt in *Skippy Hollywood Theatre* (1945), and BBC and CBS special dispatches on the invasion of Poland and Operation Pied Piper (1939–1947):
